entries.land_description: Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor's house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm.
entries.notes: Visitors may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night's stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There's no electricity in Star House. We have/are: 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).

entries.land_description: Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land., leashed dogs, work exchanges.

entries.land_description: Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.

entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl and boy children
entries.notes: We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children. Write or call first. Absolutely no drop ins. We have/are: 6 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on and working the land.

entries.land_description: A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women - workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping.
entries.notes: The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.

entries.land_description: Single woman living on basically undeveloped land.
entries.notes: Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for some work. Please write ahead of time. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 16 acres, camping space, woods, women living on and working the land.

entries.notes: Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.

entries.land_description: Key West's only guest house for and by women. Our individually decorated rooms (after famous women) all have baths, air conditioning and TV. We have a pool, large hot tub and sundecks.
entries.welcomed_groups: new guests, girl and boy children over 9 years (others by prior arrangement), lesbians, nonlesbian women who understand

entries.land_description: I live alone. The house is large, there is an upstairs with private bath and accommodations for 4 or 6. Kitchen is shared. I have canoes, tubes, and a whirl-pool (hot tub) and a game room. House is luxurious/outdoors rustic. A river is 20' from the front door.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs (outside please due to indoor cat)
entries.notes: I have: housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
